id: title:Gilbert09:cpu billing attribution for hogland sandboxes

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Hogland-specific CPU billing and sandbox backend identity fields, while explicitly excluding Hogland from burstable resources and distinguishing its idle TTL behavior from Modal. This supports differentiated billing and resource allocation for Hogland, though the shared billing implementation and Modal-specific execution are absent.
review.reason: Adds Hogland-specific CPU billing and sandbox backend identity fields, while explicitly excluding Hogland from burstable resources and distinguishing its idle TTL behavior from Modal. review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the Modal sandbox's CPU billing or the shared billing logic, so the broader systemic benefit and complete billing behavior cannot be assessed. The tier is assigned based on the visible Hogland-specific implementation and its tests, not the unverified shared or Modal components.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the Modal sandbox's CPU billing, only the Hogland-specific implementation and its tests. The Modal implementation is absent, so the shared billing logic and its application to the Modal backend cannot be assessed. No score is assigned.
